caption:
Koko tossed and turned and got about three hours of sleep. Same old knee, but today it feels much louder.

Research suggests even one poor night can make the nervous system more sensitive, so the same niggle feels bigger the next day. It's not new damage. Pain makes sleep harder, poor sleep turns pain up, and round it goes.

The good news: nudging either side often helps the other. Try steady bed and wake times, early daylight, caffeine before lunch and a screen-free last half hour.

If pain wakes you every night or comes with fever or weight loss, see your GP. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help with the pain side. Book online via the link in bio.
